en.summary: This commit re-applies the CSC exact-entry-stride read-alignment fix, restoring the strict-greater-than jump threshold and full-width shift-counter increment so stride-equals-entry traffic no longer enters the wrong path.
why_it_counts: The patch changes the same CSC image-read control and shift logic that determines exact-entry alignment behavior.
The modified conditions directly affect whether equality with one entry is treated as a jump case.
Although the subject is phrased as a recovery, the RTL diff is still a concrete DUT bug fix.
disqualifiers: This is a recovery or re-application commit rather than the first introduction of the fix.
evidence: The patch again changes pixel_x_byte_stride guards from >= CSC_ENTRY_HEX to > CSC_ENTRY_HEX.
The rsp_sft_cnt_l* increment expressions again widen the stride slice from [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] to [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2:0].
All changes are in NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v and are limited to image read alignment logic.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This record captures the same semantic bug as the prior exact-entry-stride fix: if stride equal to one entry is treated as a jump-read condition, the loader performs an unnecessary extra-read or shift adjustment. The repair was re-applied in this commit because equality at the entry boundary still needed to be excluded from jump handling and the rolling shift counters still needed the full stride increment.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: exact-entry stride classification and shift-counter increment
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The pixel or element stride is exactly one internal buffer entry wide.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reclassify stride-equals-entry as a jump path or truncate the shift-counter increment used for that equality case.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: inclusive boundary predicate and narrow stride slice
portability_notes: This is the same cross-DUT bug mechanism as dataset 168, but captured here as a separate re-applied fix commit.
Target the equality boundary between normal next-entry progression and true multi-entry jump handling.
The source repository file name is not required; any image-read aligner with an exact-entry boundary can host the same fault.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the jump-read enable condition in the image loader and change the strict-greater-than boundary back to greater-than-or-equal.
Locate the shift-position update for the same path and reduce the stride increment to the older narrow low-bit slice.
Keep address generation and downstream masking unchanged so only the equality boundary behavior regresses.
Exercise a configuration where the stride is exactly one entry to trigger the fault.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC image read exact-entry boundary handling
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit restores the '> entry' jump threshold and the full-width stride slice in rsp_sft_cnt_l* updates so pixel_w_cnt equal to one CSC entry no longer takes the wrong shift path.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v, revert the 'pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX' tests back to '>=' and restore the older [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] stride slice inside rsp_sft_cnt_l* increment logic.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Exact-entry-stride image reads are misclassified as jump or over-shift cases, causing data alignment errors at entry boundaries.
evidence_for_injection: The patch content is a direct RTL correction in the image read shift path, not a metadata-only recovery.
The same equality boundary and stride-slice expressions are modified as in the earlier exact-entry-stride fix.
The subject wording matches the idea that a previously needed fix had to be restored.
notes: This entry is intentionally similar to dataset 168 because the underlying reinjectable bug mechanism is the same.
Confidence is medium because the subject is terse, but the RTL semantics are still clear.

zh.summary: 该提交重新恢复了 CSC 在精确一 entry stride 条件下的读对齐修复，再次把 jump 阈值限定为严格大于一个 entry，并恢复完整 stride 位宽的 shift 计数更新，避免 stride 等于一个 entry 时进入错误路径。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是决定 exact-entry 对齐行为的同一组 CSC 图像读控制与 shift 逻辑。
被修改的条件直接影响“等于一个 entry”是否被错误当成 jump。
虽然标题写成 recover，但 RTL 差异本身仍然是明确的 DUT 故障修复。
disqualifiers: 这是一次恢复或重新应用修复的提交，而不是首次引入该修复。
evidence: 补丁再次把 pixel_x_byte_stride 条件从 >= CSC_ENTRY_HEX 改成了 > CSC_ENTRY_HEX。
rsp_sft_cnt_l* 的增量表达式再次把 stride 位切片从 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] 扩展到了 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2:0]。
所有改动都位于 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v，且只作用于图像读对齐逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该记录描述的语义故障与前一个 exact-entry-stride 修复相同：如果把 stride 等于一个 entry 也当成 jump-read 情况，加载器就会执行多余的额外读取或 shift 调整。这个提交之所以存在，是因为必须再次恢复对 equality 边界的正确处理，即把 stride 等于一个 entry 排除在 jump 条件之外，同时让滚动 shift 计数器继续使用完整 stride 增量。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 精确一 entry stride 分类与 shift 计数增量
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 像素或元素 stride 恰好等于一个内部 buffer entry。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新把 stride 等于一个 entry 归入 jump 路径，或把该 equality 场景下使用的 shift 计数增量截窄。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: inclusive boundary predicate and narrow stride slice
portability_notes: 它与 dataset 168 属于同一种跨 DUT 故障机理，只是这里记录的是该修复被重新应用的一次提交。
应定位到普通 next-entry 推进与真实 multi-entry jump 处理之间的 equality 边界。
不需要依赖源仓库文件名；任何带有 exact-entry 边界的图像读取对齐器都可以映射此故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到图像加载器中的 jump-read 使能条件，把严格大于边界改回大于等于。
找到同一路径上的 shift 位置更新逻辑，把 stride 增量缩回旧的窄低位切片。
保持地址生成和下游掩码逻辑不变，使唯一回退点就是 equality 边界行为。
使用 stride 恰好等于一个 entry 的配置来触发故障。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 图像读 exact-entry 边界处理
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交恢复了 '> entry' 的 jump 阈值，并在 rsp_sft_cnt_l* 更新中恢复完整 stride 位切片，使 pixel_w_cnt 等于一个 CSC entry 时不再走错移位路径。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中，把 'pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX' 改回 '>='，并在 rsp_sft_cnt_l* 增量逻辑中恢复旧的 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] stride 位切片。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 精确一 entry stride 的图像读取会被误判为 jump 或过度 shift，导致 entry 边界处的数据对齐错误。
evidence_for_injection: 该补丁内容是图像读移位路径上的直接 RTL 修正，而不是仅做元数据恢复。
它修改了与早先 exact-entry-stride 修复相同的 equality 边界和 stride 切片表达式。
标题中的 recover 与“之前需要的修复必须恢复”这一事实相吻合。
notes: 因此该条目与 dataset 168 的注入方案相似是合理且有依据的。
由于标题比较简略，置信度设为 medium，但 RTL 语义仍然清晰。
